c.tagline: Sun-drenched Ceará capital of Beira Mar, forró nights, and Praia do Futuro.

taxi.fareNote: City taxis are metered; ride-hailing apps (Uber, 99) are widely used and usually cheaper than street taxis.

emergency.note: 193 reaches the fire brigade; 190 is the military police; 192 summons SAMU ambulances.

avoid.reason: Elevated violent crime; caution on Praia de Iracema seafront at night and peripheral areas

hood_desc: Fortaleza's prime beachfront district along Avenida Beira Mar, with a wide seaside promenade, the nightly craft fair, hotels, restaurants and beach kiosks; the safest, most central base for most visitors.

The beach neighborhood closest to downtown, home to the Ponte dos Ingleses pier, the Centro Dragão do Mar cultural complex and the city's liveliest bar-and-club nightlife strip; walkable to the center.
The eastern continuation of Beira Mar ending at a working fishing colony and the Mercado dos Peixes, quieter and known for sunrise views over the jangada sailboats; a calmer seaside stay.
An upscale residential district just inland from the beach, packed with shopping malls, shops, restaurants and hospitals; a convenient, safe base a short ride from the sand.
A long, open-sea beach lined with large barracas (beach clubs) famous for fried fish, crab nights and weekend live music; a lively beach-day and nightlife destination away from the hotel strip.

transit.pay: Buses and BRT use the rechargeable Bilhete Único card or cash to the driver (about R$4.50 a ride, with free transfers within two hours on the card); the VLT light rail uses its own low-fare ticket.
transit.hours: City buses and BRT run roughly 5am to midnight; the VLT Parangaba–Mucuripe light rail runs a more limited daytime schedule.
transit.note: Fortaleza's public transport is a large municipal bus network (Topbus+) with BRT corridors, plus the VLT Parangaba–Mucuripe light-rail line linking inland train districts to the port; the Beira Mar beachfront itself is very walkable.

transit.m: Topbus+ / municipal bus to Beira Mar and center (~40 min)
Taxi or ride-hail to Beira Mar (15-25 min)

tip.r: A 10% service charge is usually already added to restaurant bills; extra tipping is optional.
